common.v1Body: This is a basic placeholder UI so we can iterate fast. Real logic + backend wiring comes next.

auth.title: Welcome back
auth.subtitle: Sign in to sync across devices. You can skip for now.

features.title: Feature Hub
features.subtitle: All the V1 screens live here so we don’t get lost in the sauce.
features.noteBody: Each page is a thin UI slice. We’ll implement real data + actions one by one.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.body: Sets expectations: scan time, privacy, what you’ll see first, and next steps.

scan.title: Progressive scanning
scan.body: Live progress, partial results, and a clear 'what’s happening' timeline.

subs.title: Subscriptions + Logos
subs.body: Subscription list that uses real brand logos/colors (Brandfetch/Logo.dev + favicon fallback).

proof.title: Tap-to-proof
proof.body: Every item can show the exact email snippet/receipt that created it.

trial.title: Trial radar
trial.body: Trials ending soon with big actions: Cancel / Remind me / Keep.

price.title: Price increase alerts
price.body: Before/after price, effective date, and suggested next action.

optimize.title: Optimize
optimize.body: Duplicates, downgrades, and annual-switch savings suggestions.

digest.title: Weekly digest (in-app)
digest.body: You saved / you’ll pay / what changed + shareable highlights.

search.title: Smart search + filters
search.body: Filter by category, cost, renewal date, trial, provider, confidence.

manual.title: Manual add + upload receipt/PDF
manual.body: Camera → confirm fields → done. Native feel, zero friction.

brand.title: Brand pages
brand.body: Logo, plan history, last charge, cancel/manage buttons + related emails.

empty.title: Empty states
empty.body: If 0 found: try broader scan, connect other inbox, upload receipt, or add manually.

home.namePromptBody: This shows up in your greeting and account profile.
home.noActions: You’re clear. Add more recurring items to unlock smarter prompts.
home.noRecurringBody: Add one manually, or connect your inbox to auto-detect renewals.

insights.subtitle: Your recurring burn rate, in plain English.
insights.connectBody: Optional, but it unlocks auto-detection. You can disconnect any time.
insights.calendarTitle: See every renewal on a timeline
insights.calendarBody: Tap a day → see what’s charging. No guessing.
insights.recapLocked: Add subscriptions to unlock recap recommendations.
insights.next30Body: Expected renewals and bills in the next 30 days (your share).
insights.suggestionsEmpty: Add recurring expenses to unlock better insights.
insights.tip1: • Use Recap monthly to trim low-value spend.
insights.tip2: • Flag shared expenses — your totals become reality-based.
insights.tip3: • Keep next due dates clean: the calendar is your profit center.
insights.title: Insights
insights.cashFlowSub: Swipe to switch charts. Tap bars to inspect.
insights.addMoreItems: Add a few recurring items to unlock this.
insights.noDataYet: Add a subscription to see charts

account.proActiveBody: Unlimited recurring items + premium tools unlocked.
account.goProBody: Unlimited recurring items, export, advanced scan, IMAP import, and the insights heatmap.
account.cameraPerm: We need camera permission to take a photo.
account.photosPerm: We need photo library permission to upload an image.

ob.langBody: You can change this anytime in Account.
ob.promiseBody: Cancel the junk. Keep the good stuff.
ob.b1Body: We scan confirmations and renewal emails to detect subscriptions.
ob.b2Body: Tap any subscription to see the exact email that created it.
ob.privacyBody: We keep this simple: receipts only, read-only, your rules.
ob.p1Body: We don’t send emails. We only read to find receipts.
ob.p2Body: We focus on billing and renewal signals, not your personal messages.
ob.p3Body: You can disconnect and delete your data whenever you want.
ob.connectBody: Optional — but it unlocks automatic detection.
ob.connectHint: Takes ~1–3 minutes. You can keep using the app while it scans.
ob.scanSetupBody: Pick a range. Wider scans find more subscriptions.
ob.includePromosSub: May find more, but can add noise.
ob.scanningHint: You can view results as soon as we find the first one.
ob.resultsBody: Review what we found. Then confirm to improve accuracy.
ob.goalsTitle: What do you want to do?
ob.notifBody: Trial ending reminders + renewal alerts (no spam).

connect.title: Connect your inbox
connect.subtitle: Automatic detection
connect.heading: We scan, you decide
connect.body: Connect your inbox and we'll automatically find subscriptions and upcoming renewals from your billing emails.
connect.bullet1: We only scan billing and renewal emails
connect.bullet2: We never send email or modify your inbox
connect.footnote: Works with Gmail. Outlook, Yahoo, and iCloud coming soon.

done.title: Add manually
done.subtitle: Enter your own subscriptions
done.heading: Track anything you like
done.body: Add subscriptions by name, amount, and billing date. You stay in full control of what's tracked.
done.bullet2: Set the amount and billing cadence
done.bullet3: You can always connect your inbox later

notif.title: Notifications
notif.subtitle: Renewal and charge reminders
notif.masterSubtitle: Get notified before subscriptions and bills charge your card.
notif.remind7dSub: Early heads-up — time to cancel or downgrade.
notif.remind3dSub: Enough time to act without forgetting.
notif.footnote: Reminders are sent at 9 AM on the day they're due.

recurring_screen.title: All recurring
recurring_screen.nothingTrackedBody: Add one recurring item to start.
recurring_screen.noMatchesBody: Try clearing filters or searching by domain.

brand_screen.noEmailsBody: Connect your inbox to automatically verify renewals and receipts.

expect.step1B1: Read-only — we never send or delete anything
expect.step1B2: We scan for billing and renewal emails only
expect.step1B3: Disconnect instantly from your account settings
expect.step2B1: Scan takes 1–3 minutes in the background
expect.step2B3: The more history, the more we find
expect.step3B1: Nothing is added without your confirmation
expect.step3B2: Tap any item to see the exact email behind it
expect.step3B3: Get alerts before charges hit your card

scanActivity.title: Scan activity
scanActivity.subtitle: A timeline of your inbox scans
scanActivity.noScansBody: Run a scan from the Mail Scan page and it will appear here.

reviewQueue.title: Review subscriptions
reviewQueue.subtitle: Confirm subscriptions before they bill

reviewQueue.addManuallyHint: You can also add subscriptions manually anytime.
reviewQueue.privacyNote:
BeforeItBills only scans subscription emails.
We never store payment details.

upgrade.title: Upgrade
upgrade.proBody: Get warned 3 days before every charge — not 24 hours. Plus unlimited scans, spend trends, price increase alerts, and cancellation shortcuts.
upgrade.disclaimer: Cancel anytime · restore anytime · mail access is read-only · no ads, ever.

export.title: Export data
export.subtitle: Download your subscriptions
export.csvDesc: Export all subscriptions and bills as a spreadsheet-compatible CSV file.
export.jsonDesc: Full data backup including all fields. Useful for transferring to another device.
